analysis:
The PR adds the literal key "DARKBLOOM_TTFT_GDN_BLOCKED" to LaunchAgent.inferencePassthroughEnvKeys (LaunchAgent.swift head line 295), with an explanatory comment at head lines 276-279. It also adds a test in LaunchAgentRestartTests.swift (head lines 2 and 236-259). The test checks three things: the key is forwarded into the launchd plist EnvironmentVariables, the key is absent from WatchdogAgent.passthroughEnvKeys, and unrelated environment variables stay excluded.

Security relevance: the passthrough is still allowlist-based and forwards only non-empty values (head lines 330-334). It copies an operator-shell value into the operator-owned plist. The operator already controls that plist and the environment under TB-003/ADV-001, so no new trust is crossed. The flag selects between bit-exact GDN prompt kernels, which is a performance rollback. It does not touch encryption (T-008), prefix-cache gating or scope (T-041/SEC-035), attestation or App Attest worker selection (TB-011; the worker opt-in at lines 336-339 is unchanged), or the fan helper (TB-010). No coordinator-controlled input reaches this key.

Unverified contract: GatedDeltaPrefill.envFlag lives in MLXLLM and is not supplied. The test asserts it equals the literal key, and the SDK's handling of invalid values is not visible here. A kernel-mode mismatch would affect only performance or correctness, not confidentiality, per the comment. No regression identified.
